DesignSystemPreview.title: Visual system, working parts.
DesignSystemPreview.intro: Reusable portfolio tokens and components. This development view helps review interface decisions; it is not a public page.
DesignSystemPreview.colorDescription: The approved palette is assigned by role and keeps strong contrast with black ink.
DesignSystemPreview.typographyDescription: Space Grotesk carries the editorial voice; Space Mono is reserved for data and code.
DesignSystemPreview.spacingDescription: A four-pixel scale organizes gaps, containers, and responsive columns.
DesignSystemPreview.componentsDescription: Real focus, press, disabled, and action states without template patterns.
DesignSystemPreview.surfacesDescription: Firm borders, offset shadows, and media frames with explicit dimensions.
DesignSystemPreview.motionDescription: Press confirms an action; transitions explain changes and respect reduced motion.
DesignSystemPreview.bodySample: Reading text with a comfortable measure and rhythm designed for real content.
DesignSystemPreview.copyError: Could not copy. Select and copy the value manually.
DesignSystemPreview.dialogBody: This dialog keeps focus, responds to Escape, and returns control to its opener.
DesignSystemPreview.cardDescription: Illustrative content for reviewing image, title, and description relationships.
DesignSystemPreview.layoutDescription: At 320, 390, 768, 1024, and 1440 pixels, columns reorganize without horizontal scrolling.
